topics.title: Double billing
topics.summary: The user reported a suspected duplicate charge and confirmed two payments for the same subscription. Invoice reference FAC-2026-7781 provided.

supportKnowledgeSummary.summary: Retrieval clarified possible technical causes for duplicate billing, including unhandled Stripe invoice events, SCA renewal gaps, and a misconfigured Stripe API wrapper. No customer-facing knowledge was found. Previous support knowledge remains empty.
supportKnowledgeSummary.supportFacing: Possible causes for duplicate billing include unhandled Stripe invoice events (payment_succeeded, payment_failed), SCA renewal gaps without user notification, and a misconfigured Stripe API wrapper. The system only supports card payments. Investigate Stripe webhook handling and API configuration.

lastUserVerbatim: Oui, j'ai bien deux prélèvements pour le même abonnement. La référence facture est FAC-2026-7781.
